_comment: The one sanctioned role-synonym vocabulary for palette slugs (FP-1 exception, Bean 2026-10-24): how a draft author's own declarations name a framework palette role. aliasNames: a var() alias token's name (its shared namespace prefix removed) that is not itself a theme.json slug -> the slug it declares. commentPhrases: a phrase in the comment beside a token declaration, or in a README line naming a hex, -> the slug it states. A name equal to a theme.json slug needs no entry. Read by lib/intake-palette-declared.mjs; tests/intake-palette-declared.test.mjs checks every slug here exists in theme.json.
